# id: PG-pg-81-balance-robotics
# covers: PG 186 (Section L balance sweep, generated by tools/balance_driver.py gen; edit the generator, not this file)
# fixture: Testing-Save-Full-Base (squad Avarek + Beaks)
# reset: fresh
# needs: ProfessionGearProgression.dll 36D7474D+ (pg_statprobe), harness c5a5c88+ (give artifacts, research start any; 90a0e33: teleport moved=/bed, speed hold; 6933d0f: fill topup, drop all; 616121b: benches near; c4fa520: pin, d91fe88: face) (KAH 24: chance, detect, detecttime, healtime, findwater, swimtime, construct, construction); client kah.py from the harness repo (LONG_COMMANDS has the KAH 24 timers); set_test_mode.ps1 -Mode Forced -Rules InGameTest
# design: Beaks works the Robotics Bench (real craft job, Gears queued 5 more per point); the bench input is refilled
#   with Iron Plates before every 30-game-minute window at speed 3. Result = items made in the window:
#   queue drop + progress of the first queued item (benches prints it with 4 decimals, harness
#   after 33087EDE). Skills 10/90 without gear, then 3 x (skill 50: none / +25% / +50% robotics / +50%
#   Labouring control), then the sanity pair.
# verify: every window has a BAL2 line with Q/F values on both sides and made > 0 at skill 50;
#   own > none = the bench reads the hooked stat.
#   Data: python3 tools/balance_driver.py csv <out> > balance.csv; python3 tools/analyze_balance.py balance.csv
@wait-world
@sleep 8
speed 0
wake Beaks
speed 1 hold
@sleep 4
speed 0
protect Avarek on
protect Beaks on
health Beaks 100
health Avarek 100
blood Beaks 100%
blood Avarek 100%
hunger Beaks 280
hunger Avarek 280
select Beaks
clearjobs Beaks
pg_statprobe on Beaks
wake Avarek
pin Avarek ~ pinned
research "Robotics"
speed 1 hold
@sleep 2
speed 0
wake Beaks
speed 1 hold
@sleep 3
speed 0
@until 30 teleport Beaks building "Robotics Bench" dist 4 radius 1500 ~ moved=1
pin Avarek off ~ unpinned
@until 30 teleport Avarek Beaks dist 8 ~ moved=1
pin Avarek ~ pinned
@until 30 teleport Avarek Beaks dist 8 ~ moved=1
benches 60 crafts ~ Robotics Bench[^|]*Gears
power "Robotics Bench" supply radius 60
give Beaks "Iron Hat" 1
equip Beaks "Iron Hat"
pg_info Beaks "Iron Hat" ~ equipped=1
# --- w1: skill 10, gear none ---
setstat Beaks robotics 10
pg_clear Beaks ~ cleared affixes
wake Beaks
speed 1 hold
@sleep 3
speed 0
@until 30 teleport Beaks building "Robotics Bench" dist 4 radius 1500 ~ moved=1
pin Avarek off ~ unpinned
@until 30 teleport Avarek Beaks dist 8 ~ moved=1
pin Avarek ~ pinned
craft Beaks "Gears" at "Robotics Bench" count 5 ~ queued
fill "Robotics Bench" "Iron Plates" 15 radius 60 topup
@echo READY
where Beaks ~ ^(?!.*\b(KO|DEAD)\b)
benches 60 near Beaks ~ Robotics Bench[^|]*(?:\|[^|]+)*?\| in\d[^|]*\[Iron Plates x[1-9]
benches 8 near Beaks ~ Robotics Bench[^|]*queue=[1-9]
jobs Beaks ~ jobs=[1-9]
building "Robotics Bench" 60 ~ power_on=1 .*broken=0 .*(wants=0(\.0+)?\s|supplied=1)
@set Q0 benches 60 near Beaks ~ Robotics Bench[^|]*queue=(\d+)
@set F0 benches 60 near Beaks ~ Robotics Bench[^|]*queue=\d+ \(first: [^|]*? ([\d.]+)%\)
stat Beaks robotics ~ wounds=1\.0000
@set T0 time ~ game_hours=([\d.]+)
speed 3 hold
@wait-game 30 900
speed 0
@set T1 time ~ game_hours=([\d.]+)
stat Beaks robotics
where Beaks
jobs Beaks
@echo POST
where Beaks ~ ^(?!.*\b(KO|DEAD)\b)
benches 8 near Beaks ~ Robotics Bench
@set Q1 benches 60 near Beaks ~ Robotics Bench[^|]*queue=(\d+)
@set F1 benches 60 near Beaks ~ Robotics Bench[^|]*queue=\d+ \(first: [^|]*? ([\d.]+)%\)
@echo BAL2,186,robotics,10,0,none,w1,craft,T${T0}_${T1},${Q0}/${F0},${Q1}/${F1}
pg_statprobe read
hunger Beaks 280
# --- w2: skill 90, gear none ---
setstat Beaks robotics 90
pg_clear Beaks ~ cleared affixes
wake Beaks
speed 1 hold
@sleep 3
speed 0
@until 30 teleport Beaks building "Robotics Bench" dist 4 radius 1500 ~ moved=1

@set F0 benches 60 near Beaks ~ Robotics Bench[^|]*queue=\d+ \(first: [^|]*? ([\d.]+)%\)

@echo BAL2,186,robotics,90,0,none,w2,craft,T${T0}_${T1},${Q0}/${F0},${Q1}/${F1}

@echo BAL2,186,robotics,50,25,own25,w12,craft,T${T0}_${T1},${Q0}/${F0},${Q1}/${F1}
pg_statprobe read
hunger Beaks 280
# --- w13: skill 50, gear own50 ---
setstat Beaks robotics 50
pg_clear Beaks ~ cleared affixes
pg_force_affix Beaks "Iron Hat" robotics 50 tier 6 ~ affixes=
pg_bonus Beaks robotics ~ equipped_bonus=50% .*match=1
pg_statprobe read
wake Beaks
speed 1 hold
@sleep 3
speed 0
@until 30 teleport Beaks building "Robotics Bench" dist 4 radius 1500 ~ moved=1
pin Avarek off ~ unpinned
@until 30 teleport Avarek Beaks dist 8 ~ moved=1
pin Avarek ~ pinned
craft Beaks "Gears" at "Robotics Bench" count 5 ~ queued
fill "Robotics Bench" "Iron Plates" 15 radius 60 topup
@echo READY
where Beaks ~ ^(?!.*\b(KO|DEAD)\b)
benches 60 near Beaks ~ Robotics Bench[^|]*(?:\|[^|]+)*?\| in\d[^|]*\[Iron Plates x[1-9]
benches 8 near Beaks ~ Robotics Bench[^|]*queue=[1-9]
jobs Beaks ~ jobs=[1-9]
building "Robotics Bench" 60 ~ power_on=1 .*broken=0 .*(wants=0(\.0+)?\s|supplied=1)
@set Q0 benches 60 near Beaks ~ Robotics Bench[^|]*queue=(\d+)
@set F0 benches 60 near Beaks ~ Robotics Bench[^|]*queue=\d+ \(first: [^|]*? ([\d.]+)%\)
stat Beaks robotics ~ wounds=1\.0000
@set T0 time ~ game_hours=([\d.]+)
speed 3 hold
@wait-game 30 900
speed 0
@set T1 time ~ game_hours=([\d.]+)
stat Beaks robotics
where Beaks
jobs Beaks
@echo POST
where Beaks ~ ^(?!.*\b(KO|DEAD)\b)
